referenceMethod: Native video remote streaming and seek screenshots. No source video downloaded. Source texts and frames are evidence; author pipeline claims remain claims.

validation.browser: Headless Chromium on Windows. Desktop 1440x1000/1050; mobile 390x900 with actual emulated touch events. No physical-phone performance claim.
validation.time: Automated gameplay uses browser-controlled clock and actual input handlers/physics. Durations are game time, not wall-clock execution time.
validation.quest: Final three sites plus hub submission completed after obstacle-aware route correction.
validation.defense: Three waves and twelve robots won via actual aim/fire/recharge; reset and passive pursuit reaches health-zero loss.
validation.mascot: Default sandbox, real vertex indentation/height feedback; optional challenge actual win and timeout.
validation.soccer: Three goals through actual steering/driving: game time 13.5s, three contacts. 90s passive run times out. Boost, jump, ball height, camera and export separately verified.
validation.lifecycle: All four hidden runtimes freeze; no-WebGL fallback starts; dispose stops runtime and removes owned DOM.

authorClaims: Browser RPG with quests, dialogue trees, VATS and Pip-Boy.
Buildings, faces, weapons and sounds generated by code; no texture or sound files.
observed: 25s first-person outdoor city and railway scene.
retainedCore: Procedural 3D street blocks, windows, signs and simple original NPCs.
First-person walking, camera look, obstacle collision and automatic routes around obstacles.
Branching evidence quest with terminal task/equipment/map tabs.
Oscillator-based synthesized cues, no image/audio assets for the scene.
boundaries: Small original block, not a full Fallout recreation.
Equipment is a task log, not a full inventory/weapon system.
No VATS or original combat/source code/assets reproduced.

authorClaims: Opus and Astra used to pull Call of Duty World at War source and port the classic zombies map to web.
observed: 6s first-person room, firearm, visible enemy and firing effects.
20s aimed weapon, explosion effects, wave/score HUD.
retainedCore: Original first-person server room and mechanical enemies.
Walking/look/aim plus real camera-ray shooting and rack occlusion.
Recharge, enemy pursuit/contact damage, three-wave survival, actual win/loss.
boundaries: Not a COD source or asset port; original source/license/port internals not verified.
Simplified pursuit and room collision, no multiplayer or original maps/weapons.

authorClaims: Fourth game made since model release; author reports efficiency gains.
observed: 5s pink rabbit, orange soft character and mint cat; cat is elevated after interaction.
25s settings show squishy mode, satisfaction/volume, haptics, screen shake, gravity and dark-mode options; blending/add UI visible.
retainedCore: Three original procedural 3D character silhouettes with clearcoat highlights.
Raycast poke/drag, local vertex indentation, spring squash/rebound, real gravity height/bounce.
Softness, gravity and synthesized-sound controls; default free-touch sandbox.
boundaries: Spring and vertex-displacement approximation, not a full soft-body solver.
Original shaders and internal interaction algorithms not inspected.
No original blending/slime/haptics features claimed; combo challenge explicitly our optional extension.

authorClaims: Browser car-football fan project; author praises physics/mechanics.
observed: 5s car and ball airborne in a 3D stadium, BALL CAM and BOOST meter.
20s car aerial rotation and changing BOOST value.
retainedCore: Original 3D stadium, car/ball models, driving and steering.
Car jump, actual ball height/gravity/bounce, contacts, Boost energy and real goals.
Chase/ball cameras following simulation coordinates; adjustable friction and restitution.
boundaries: Own simplified sphere-contact and ground-traction model.
No full six-degree-of-freedom vehicle rigid-body, aerial roll, original assets or multiplayer.
Demo parameters are not calibrated physical units.
